policy.fit: Official train only; memorize complete gold entity token tuples, never subphrases.
policy.interpretation: Implements the paper description. Case sensitivity and equal-length/crossing-overlap resolution are explicit project choices; exact identity to the historical executable is not established.
policy.matching: Exact original tokens, case-sensitive; no normalization, substring matches or external gazetteers.
policy.output: IOB2: B at each accepted entity start, I inside, O elsewhere. Adjacent entities remain separate. Never cross sentence boundaries.
policy.overlap: Collect all sentence-local matches; accept by descending token length, then ascending start offset, skipping any occupied token. Finally sort by start.
policy.selection: One preregistered configuration; no hyperparameters, CV, frequency cutoff or validation/test-based changes.
policy.tie_break: Equal-length overlapping matches prefer the earlier start. A retained surface has only one type.
policy.unique: Keep a surface only when its complete training entities have exactly one NE type; discard all multi-type surfaces regardless of frequency. O is not an entity type.
